title: How Far Did They Go? The Persuasive Tactics of Covert LLM Agents in a Discontinued Field Experiment
summary: This study analyzes a publicly released dataset from a discontinued field experiment on Reddit's r/ChangeMyView. The intervention, conducted by unknown, external researchers and halted following ethical backlash, involved undisclosed AI-generated accounts engaging users in live debate. After public disclosure, Reddit authorized moderators to release an archive of the AI-generated comments, creating a rare opportunity to examine how large language models operated in an identity-rich deliberative forum without disclosure. We conduct a structured content analysis of this corpus, evaluating identity performance, authority signaling, alignment strategies, and activation of cognitive heuristics. Identity targeting or adoption appears in over two-thirds of comments, alignment moves and authority claims in nearly all of them, and cognitive-bias triggers -- particularly confirmation bias, representativeness, and availability -- in the large majority. These patterns co-occur systematically, composing a rhetorical architecture calibrated for persuasive efficiency rather than authentic deliberative participation. Compared against human-authored CMV counter-arguments, the agents inverted the typical distribution on every dimension: denser authority use, more adversarial alignment, and heavier reliance on external citation over experiential grounding. In such environments, distinctions between authentic and synthetic epistemic standing grow increasingly opaque -- an asymmetry that disclosure mandates alone cannot address. The results point toward auditing frameworks capable of assessing how AI systems structure credibility, not merely whether they are present.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了Reddit r/ChangeMyView上一个被叫停的外部实验数据集——未经披露的AI生成账户与用户进行实时辩论。通过结构化内容分析，发现AI评论大量使用身份定位、权威信号、对齐策略和认知偏差触发（如确认偏差、代表性启发、可得性启发），形成一套面向说服效率而非真实参与的修辞架构，且与人类反论点相比，在权威使用、对抗性对齐和外部引用等维度上呈现反转分布。
AI.motivation: 利用一个罕见的公开数据集——Reddit r/ChangeMyView上被叫停的AI辩论实验——来研究大语言模型在身份丰富的审议性论坛中未经披露地运行时，其话语策略和修辞架构的特征，以及这种合成存在对真实辩论生态的潜在影响。
AI.method: 对公开的AI生成评论语料进行结构化内容分析，评估身份表现、权威信号、对齐策略和认知启发式的激活情况，并与人类撰写的CMV反论点进行对比分析。
AI.result: 超过三分之二的评论存在身份定位或采纳，几乎所有评论都有对齐动作和权威主张，大多数评论触发了认知偏差（特别是确认偏差、代表性和可得性）。这些模式系统性地共现，构成面向说服效率的修辞架构。与人类反论点相比，AI评论在权威使用密度、对抗性对齐程度和外部引用依赖度上呈现反转分布。
AI.conclusion: 在AI参与的环境中，真实与合成认知地位之间的区别日益模糊，仅靠披露要求无法解决这一问题。研究指向需要能够评估AI系统如何构建可信度（而不仅仅是是否存在的审计框架。
idea_en: A method for detecting undisclosed AI participation in online deliberative forums by analyzing rhetorical architecture patterns including identity targeting frequency, authority signaling density, and cognitive bias trigger co-occurrence rates.

A system for auditing AI-generated persuasive content based on inverted distribution metrics comparing AI vs. human argumentation patterns across dimensions of authority use, adversarial alignment, and citation reliance.

An algorithmic framework for assessing epistemic standing asymmetry in mixed human-AI discourse environments, quantifying opacity between authentic and synthetic knowledge claims beyond simple disclosure.
A technique for identifying AI-generated debate comments through systematic co-occurrence analysis of identity performance, alignment moves, and cognitive heuristic activation patterns.
A method for evaluating persuasive efficiency vs. authentic deliberative participation in AI systems by measuring rhetorical architecture calibration across multiple discourse dimensions.
idea_ch: 一种通过分析修辞架构模式（包括身份定位频率、权威信号密度和认知偏差触发共现率）来检测在线审议论坛中未披露AI参与的方法。
一种基于反转分布指标审计AI生成说服内容的系统，比较AI与人类在权威使用、对抗性对齐和引用依赖等维度上的论证模式差异。
一种评估混合人类-AI话语环境中认知地位不对称性的算法框架，量化真实与合成知识主张之间的模糊性，超越简单的披露要求。
一种通过身份表现、对齐动作和认知启发式激活模式的系统性共现分析来识别AI生成辩论评论的技术。
一种通过跨多个话语维度测量修辞架构校准度来评估AI系统说服效率与真实审议参与度的方法。

title: What Should Agents Say? Action-state Communication for Efficient Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models are typically organized around roles, pipelines, and turn schedules, while the content that agents pass to one another is often left as unconstrained natural language. However, this free-form communication can rapidly inflate token usage, consume the shared context window, and ultimately affect both system performance and inference cost. We analyze five common inter-agent communication strategies across two MAS topologies, finding that no fixed strategy is universally optimal. Instead, effective inter-agent messages consistently preserve action-centered information needed by downstream agents. Building on this, we propose the PACT (Protocolized Action-state Communication and Transmission), which treats inter-agent communication as a public state-update problem and projects each raw agent output into a compact action-state record before it enters shared history. Across different MAS topologies, PACT consistently improves the performance-cost trade-off, achieving comparable or stronger task performance with substantially fewer tokens. The gains extend to production coding harnesses: PACT lifts OpenHands' resolve rate at -10% tokens-per-resolved, and is resolve-neutral on SWE-agent while halving input tokens. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/iNLP-Lab/PACT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PACT方法，将多智能体系统（MAS）中的智能体间通信从自由文本转化为结构化的动作-状态记录，从而显著降低token消耗、提升性能-成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中，智能体间的通信使用无约束的自然语言，导致token消耗急剧膨胀、共享上下文窗口被迅速占满，影响系统性能和推理成本。
AI.method: PACT将智能体间通信视为公共状态更新问题，每个智能体的原始输出在被写入共享历史之前，先投影为紧凑的动作-状态记录（action-state record），保留下游智能体所需的以动作为中心的信息。
AI.result: 在不同MAS拓扑结构下，PACT在性能-成本权衡上持续优于现有策略；在OpenHands上解决率提升且每个解决任务的token减少10%；在SWE-agent上解决率不变但输入token减半。
AI.conclusion: 没有固定的通信策略是普遍最优的，但有效的智能体间消息应保留以动作为中心的信息。PACT通过协议化的动作-状态通信，为多智能体系统提供了一种高效的通信范式。
idea_en: Protocolized inter-agent communication method that projects raw LLM outputs into compact action-state records before entering shared context
Public state-update formulation for multi-agent communication that treats messages as state transitions rather than free-form text
Adaptive communication strategy selection based on MAS topology and task characteristics to optimize performance-cost trade-off
Action-centered message compression technique that preserves only action-critical information needed by downstream agents
idea_ch: 协议化动作-状态通信方法：将多智能体系统中各智能体的原始输出投影为紧凑的动作-状态记录后再写入共享历史，大幅压缩token消耗
公共状态更新通信范式：将智能体间通信建模为公共状态更新问题，以结构化状态转移替代自由文本传递
基于拓扑自适应的通信策略选择机制：根据多智能体系统拓扑结构和任务特征动态选择最优通信策略
动作中心信息压缩技术：仅保留下游智能体所需的以动作为核心的关键信息，过滤冗余自然语言内容

title: I Know What You Meme, Even If it Emerged Today: Understanding Evolving Memes through Open-World Knowledge Acquisition
summary: Multimodal memes are dynamic and often require up to date background knowledge for interpretation. Existing methods often overlook such knowledge or rely on fixed parametric knowledge of pretrained models that may be incomplete, outdated, or unavailable for emerging memes. We introduce Query Retrieve Conclude, a zero shot framework that identifies missing knowledge, retrieves open web evidence, and synthesizes evidence grounded background knowledge for meme understanding and detection. We also introduce a curated meme understanding benchmark of recent memes from 2024 to 2026 with external background knowledge annotations. Experiments on three meme understanding datasets and five meme detection tasks show that our framework improves knowledge recovery, meme understanding and downstream detection over zero shot baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个零样本框架Query Retrieve Conclude (QRC)，通过识别缺失知识、检索开放网络证据并综合背景知识来理解多模态梗图，在多个数据集上优于零样本基线。
AI.motivation: 多模态梗图动态变化快，需要最新背景知识才能理解，而现有方法依赖预训练模型的固定参数知识，这些知识可能不完整、过时或无法获取新兴梗图所需的背景信息。
AI.method: Query Retrieve Conclude (QRC) 零样本框架：1) Query阶段识别缺失的知识；2) Retrieve阶段从开放网络中检索证据；3) Conclude阶段综合证据生成基于背景知识的理解，用于梗图理解和检测。
AI.result: 在三个梗图理解数据集和五个梗图检测任务上，QRC框架在知识恢复、梗图理解和下游检测方面均优于零样本基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过动态检索开放网络证据来补充背景知识，可以有效提升多模态梗图的理解和检测能力，尤其适用于新兴和快速变化的梗图。
idea_en: Query-Retrieve-Conclude (QRC) zero-shot framework for meme understanding that dynamically identifies missing background knowledge, retrieves real-time evidence from the open web, and synthesizes evidence-grounded knowledge without requiring fine-tuning or parametric knowledge updates.
A curated meme understanding benchmark (2024-2026) with comprehensive external background knowledge annotations for evaluating knowledge-dependent meme interpretation.
Novel knowledge recovery mechanism that explicitly identifies knowledge gaps in multimodal meme content before initiating web retrieval, enabling targeted evidence collection.
idea_ch: Query-Retrieve-Conclude (QRC) 零样本梗图理解框架：动态识别梗图中缺失的背景知识，从开放网络实时检索证据，并综合生成基于证据的背景知识，无需微调或更新模型参数知识。
2024-2026年梗图理解基准数据集：包含全面的外部背景知识标注，专门用于评估依赖背景知识的梗图理解能力。
知识恢复机制：在多模态梗图内容中显式识别知识缺口，然后针对性地发起网络检索，实现精准的证据收集。

title: GITCO: Gated Inference-Time Context Optimization in TSFMs
comment: ICML 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data
summary: Patch-based Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) suffer from context poisoning: structurally anomalous patches capture disproportionate attention and silently degrade zero-shot forecast quality. We propose improving TSFM accuracy at inference time by optimizing the input context rather than modifying model weights. We present GITCO (Gated Inference-Time Context Optimization), a lightweight three-component framework: Gate, Router, and Critic that selectively identifies and suppresses harmful patches without any parameter updates. Evaluated on TimesFM 2.5 across 53 GIFT-Eval datasets under K-fold cross-validation, GITCO achieves an average +1.95% MASE reduction on TimesFM 2.5 while capturing 89.9% of the improvement upper bound. We introduce context sensitivity profiles as a new characterizable property of TSFMs: the mapping from time series meta-features to expected accuracy improvement under inference-time context intervention, shaped jointly by model architecture and the statistical structure of the data.

AI.tldr: 提出GITCO框架，通过推理时优化输入上下文（而非修改模型权重）来提升时间序列基础模型的预测精度，核心是门控、路由和批评者三个组件，用于识别并抑制有害的异常patch。
AI.motivation: 基于Patch的时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）存在"上下文中毒"问题：结构异常的patch会不成比例地吸引模型注意力，无声地降低零样本预测质量。现有方法需要修改模型权重，计算成本高且不灵活。
AI.method: 提出GITCO（Gated Inference-Time Context Optimization）轻量级三组件框架：Gate（门控）选择性识别异常patch、Router（路由）调控信息流、Critic（批评者）评估并抑制有害patch，全程无需参数更新，仅在推理时优化输入上下文。
AI.result: 在TimesFM 2.5上，使用53个GIFT-Eval数据集进行K折交叉验证，平均MASE降低1.95%，达到改进上限的89.9%。
AI.conclusion: 推理时上下文优化是提升TSFM零样本预测质量的有效且轻量级方案；引入"上下文敏感性剖面"概念，描述时间序列元特征与预期精度改进之间的映射关系，该映射由模型架构和数据统计结构共同塑造。
idea_en: Gated Inference-Time Context Optimization (GITCO) framework: a lightweight three-component system (Gate, Router, Critic) that identifies and suppresses structurally anomalous patches in time series during inference without any model parameter updates.

Context sensitivity profiles for time series foundation models: a novel characterization mapping from time series meta-features to expected accuracy improvement under inference-time context intervention.
Anomaly patch detection mechanism in patch-based TSFMs that prevents context poisoning by structurally anomalous patches from capturing disproportionate attention.
idea_ch: GITCO框架：基于门控推理时上下文优化的轻量级三组件（Gate-Router-Critic）系统，无需更新模型参数，在推理时识别并抑制时间序列中的结构性异常patch
上下文敏感性剖面（Context Sensitivity Profiles）：一种新的TSFM可表征属性，建立时间序列元特征到推理时上下文干预下预期精度改进的映射关系
基于异常patch的上下文中毒防御机制：在基于Patch的时间序列基础模型中，检测并抑制异常patch导致的注意力失衡问题，提升零样本预测质量

title: Uncertainty Aware Functional Behavior Prediction and Material Fatigue Assessment for Circular Factory
comment: 27 pages, submitted to the Journal of Manufacturing Systems' special issue about circular factories, the manuscript is under review
summary: Returned products in circular factories re-enter production with heterogeneous degradation states, usage histories, and remaining capability. Reuse cannot be decided from the current inspection alone, because future function fulfillment and component integrity may evolve differently under the next service scenario. Existing PHM approaches support degradation prediction, but often target fixed operating conditions or isolated component benchmarks, while material-fatigue assessment is rarely linked to system-level functional prognosis. This paper addresses this gap for an angle grinder by combining uncertainty-aware functional prediction with component-level fatigue assessment in an instance-specific reliability workflow. The proposed framework combines the current tool state with recent force--torque usage windows. A convolutional encoder extracts loading patterns from spindle forces and shaft torque, and an LSTM backbone predicts nine functional variables as Gaussian mean and variance estimates. In parallel, the same loading history is translated into output-shaft fatigue information through finite-element-supported stress reconstruction, S--N/Miner damage evaluation with Haibach extension, and Paris-law crack-growth analysis. A streaming replay algorithm consolidates both branches into functional, material, and system reliability trajectories. Held-out tests show mean \(2\%\)-tolerance accuracy of 0.9652 across nine outputs. Thermal variables are predicted near-perfectly, while drive motor current and load speed remain the most demanding dynamic outputs, with \(R^2\) values of 0.9750 and 0.9924. Torque history is especially important for these variables, and the conventional LSTM outperforms GRU and xLSTM in the short-history setting. Reliability calibration is most informative for drive motor current, where predicted and observed exceedance probabilities ...

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合不确定性感知功能预测与组件级疲劳评估的实例特定可靠性工作流，用于圆形工厂中返回产品的复用决策。以角磨机为例，通过卷积编码器提取载荷模式、LSTM预测九项功能变量，结合有限元应力重建、S-N/Miner损伤评估和Paris裂纹扩展分析，实现功能、材料和系统可靠性轨迹的融合预测。
AI.motivation: 圆形工厂中返回产品的退化状态、使用历史和剩余能力具有高度异构性，仅凭当前检测无法决定复用，因为未来功能实现和组件完整性在不同服务场景下可能不同演化。现有PHM方法多针对固定工况或孤立组件基准，材料疲劳评估很少与系统级功能预测关联。
AI.method: 框架结合当前工具状态与近期力-扭矩使用窗口：1) 卷积编码器从主轴力和轴扭矩提取载荷模式；2) LSTM主干将九个功能变量预测为高斯均值和方差估计；3) 并行将载荷历史通过有限元应力重建、S-N/Miner损伤评估（Haibach扩展）和Paris裂纹扩展分析转化为输出轴疲劳信息；4) 流式重放算法将两分支整合为功能、材料和系统可靠性轨迹。
AI.result: 保留测试显示九个输出平均2%容差准确率为0.9652。热变量预测近乎完美，驱动电机电流和负载速度是最具挑战的动态输出，R²分别为0.9750和0.9924。扭矩历史对这些变量尤其重要，传统LSTM在短历史场景下优于GRU和xLSTM。驱动电机电流的可靠性校准最具信息量。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效实现了返回产品在圆形工厂中复用决策所需的融合预测，将功能预测与材料疲劳评估相结合，为实例特定的可靠性评估提供了可行方案。
idea_en: A method for instance-specific reliability assessment of returned products combining uncertainty-aware functional prediction with component-level fatigue assessment, using convolutional encoder for loading pattern extraction and LSTM for multivariate Gaussian prediction.
A streaming replay algorithm that consolidates functional prediction branches and material fatigue assessment branches into integrated reliability trajectories for circular factory decision-making.

A dual-branch framework that translates loading history into both functional variable predictions (via LSTM) and output-shaft fatigue information (via finite-element stress reconstruction, S-N/Miner damage evaluation with Haibach extension, and Paris-law crack-growth analysis) in parallel.

A method for predicting functional variables as Gaussian mean and variance estimates from spindle forces and shaft torque patterns using convolutional encoder and LSTM backbone, enabling uncertainty quantification in degradation prediction.
A short-history setting LSTM predictor optimized for torque-history-dependent variables, outperforming GRU and xLSTM in dynamic output prediction for power tools.
idea_ch: 一种结合不确定性感知功能预测与组件级疲劳评估的返回产品实例特定可靠性评估方法，使用卷积编码器提取载荷模式，LSTM进行多元高斯预测
一种流式重放算法，将功能预测分支和材料疲劳评估分支整合为用于循环工厂决策的综合可靠性轨迹
一种双分支框架，并行地将载荷历史转化为功能变量预测（通过LSTM）和输出轴疲劳信息（通过有限元应力重建、S-N/Miner损伤评估及Haibach扩展、Paris裂纹扩展分析）
一种从主轴力和轴扭矩模式预测功能变量为高斯均值和方差估计的方法，使用卷积编码器和LSTM主干，实现退化预测中的不确定性量化
一种针对依赖扭矩历史的变量优化的短历史LSTM预测器，在电动工具的动态输出预测中优于GRU和xLSTM

title: SentinelBench: A Benchmark for Long-Running Monitoring Agents
summary:
AI agents are increasingly asked to carry out work that spans minutes, hours, or longer. Yet the default model of agent behavior is continuous action: issuing tool calls, refreshing pages, searching for alternatives, or otherwise trying to force progress. This is the wrong approach for many long-running tasks, which are better served by a strategy of sustained attention. Instead, agents should monitor an environment, notice when an external event makes progress possible, then respond promptly without wasting resources while waiting. To measure progress on this class of tasks, we introduce SentinelBench, an open-source benchmark for time-evolving monitoring tasks.
  SentinelBench contains 100 tasks across 10 synthetic web environments, including email, calendars, finance, professional networking, and entertainment. Each environment exposes a live web interface and replays a scripted sequence of events, requiring agents to navigate and reason about web pages whose state shifts underfoot. SentinelBench measures task completion, reaction time, and resource use, exposing the tradeoff between responsiveness and cost. We report results across three models and two browser-agent harnesses, establishing performance baselines for future comparison and demonstrating how agent design choices can dramatically impact key metrics. Together, these results show that SentinelBench distinguishes meaningful differences in agent behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SentinelBench基准，用于评估AI代理在长时间、时间演化监测任务中的表现，强调"持续关注"而非"持续行动"的策略。
AI.motivation: 现有AI代理默认采用连续行动模式（不断调用工具、刷新页面等），这种方式不适合需要耐心等待外部事件触发的长时间任务，浪费计算资源且效率低下。
AI.method: 构建了包含100个任务的SentinelBench基准，覆盖10个合成网络环境（邮件、日历、金融、职场社交、娱乐等），每个环境提供实时网页界面并回放脚本化事件序列，评估任务完成度、反应时间和资源使用。
AI.result: 在三种模型和两种浏览器代理框架上建立性能基线，证明代理设计选择对关键指标有显著影响，SentinelBench能有效区分代理行为差异。
AI.conclusion: 长时间运行任务应采用"持续关注"策略替代"持续行动"策略，代理应监测环境、等待外部事件触发后再响应，以平衡响应速度与资源消耗。
idea_en: A method for AI agent operation in long-running tasks that shifts from continuous action to sustained attention monitoring, where the agent observes an environment and only triggers tool calls upon detecting specific external events.

A benchmark system (SentinelBench) comprising synthetic web environments with scripted event sequences that simulate time-evolving scenarios for evaluating agent monitoring capabilities across metrics of task completion, reaction time, and resource utilization.

A resource-adaptive agent scheduling mechanism that adjusts polling frequency and monitoring intensity based on the probability of imminent external events, reducing computational waste during low-probability waiting periods.
idea_ch: 一种AI代理长时间任务运行方法，从持续行动模式转变为持续关注监测模式，代理观察环境状态，仅在检测到特定外部事件时才触发工具调用。
一种基准测试系统（SentinelBench），包含多个合成网络环境和脚本化事件序列，模拟时间演化场景，从任务完成度、反应时间和资源消耗三个维度评估代理监测能力。
一种资源自适应代理调度机制，根据外部事件发生的概率动态调整轮询频率和监测强度，在低概率等待期间减少计算资源浪费。

title: An interpretable and trustworthy AI framework for large-scale longitudinal structure-pain association studies using data from the Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI)
summary: Purpose: To develop an interpretable and trustworthy AI framework that combines deep learning based MRI Osteoarthritis Knee Score (MOAKS) prediction with interpretable statistical modeling to study structure-pain relationships at scale using data from the Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI). Materials and Methods: We first developed a deep learning framework to predict MOAKS features directly from knee MRIs and incorporated conformal prediction to provide prediction uncertainty quantification. This uncertainty-aware strategy enables explicit filtering of model outputs, retaining only high-confidence MOAKS predictions at the knee level. Second, we applied a longitudinal latent class mixed model (LCMM) to examine associations between key structural abnormalities and four complementary knee pain measurements. Results: Among the three MRI-defined abnormalities (i.e., bone marrow lesions (BML), cartilage loss (CART), and meniscal extrusion (ME)), our framework substantially improved the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) and some other metrics. For example, MCC increased from 0.69 to 0.91 for BML, from 0.45 to 0.80 for CART, and from 0.59 to 0.89 for ME. Using these high-confidence predictions, we expanded the sample size to 2,175 knees for the LCMM analysis. Two distinct pain trajectories were identified (rapid and stable pain progression). The estimated odds ratios (95% CI) for the rapid progression group were 1.62 (1.12-2.35) for BML, 1.83 (1.24-2.70) for CART loss, and 2.50 (1.75-3.57) for ME. Conclusion: These results highlight the importance of these structural abnormalities as risk factors for pain and functional progression in osteoarthritis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合深度学习MOAKS预测与可解释统计建模的可信AI框架，利用OAI数据大规模研究膝关节结构-疼痛关系。通过共形预测实现不确定性量化，过滤高置信度预测，再使用纵向潜在类别混合模型分析结构异常与疼痛的关联。结果显示BML、CART和ME是膝骨关节炎疼痛进展的重要风险因素。
AI.motivation: 现有MRI骨关节炎评分（MOAKS）依赖人工标注，耗时且主观性强；同时，深度学习模型缺乏不确定性量化，难以在临床中建立可信的结构-疼痛关联分析。本文旨在构建一个可解释、可信赖的AI框架，实现大规模、高置信度的自动化评分及结构-疼痛关系研究。
AI.method: 1) 构建深度学习框架直接从膝部MRI预测MOAKS特征；2) 引入共形预测（conformal prediction）提供预测不确定性量化，过滤低置信度输出；3) 利用纵向潜在类别混合模型（LCMM）分析BML、软骨丢失（CART）和半月板挤压（ME）三种结构异常与四种膝痛测量的关联。
AI.result: MCC显著提升：BML从0.69→0.91，CART从0.45→0.80，ME从0.59→0.89。LCMM分析纳入2,175例膝部数据，识别出快速和稳定两种疼痛进展轨迹。快速进展组中，BML的OR=1.62，CART的OR=1.83，ME的OR=2.50。
AI.conclusion: BML、软骨丢失和半月板挤压是膝骨关节炎疼痛和功能进展的重要结构风险因素。本文提出的不确定性感知深度学习+统计建模框架可有效扩大分析样本量，提升结构-疼痛关系研究的可靠性和可解释性。
idea_en: A deep learning framework for predicting MOAKS features directly from knee MRIs with conformal prediction-based uncertainty quantification, enabling automatic filtering of low-confidence predictions.
A method combining deep learning-based MOAKS prediction with longitudinal latent class mixed model (LCMM) to study structure-pain associations at population scale.
Application of conformal prediction in musculoskeletal MRI analysis to provide prediction confidence intervals and enable explicit screening of model outputs at the knee level.
A pipeline for expanding effective sample size for pain trajectory analysis by retaining only high-confidence AI-predicted MOAKS features.
idea_ch: 基于共形预测的膝关节MRI MOAKS特征深度学习预测方法，能够自动量化预测不确定性并过滤低置信度输出
将深度学习MOAKS预测与纵向潜在类别混合模型（LCMM）相结合，在大规模人群中研究膝关节结构异常与疼痛关联的方法
在肌肉骨骼MRI分析中引入共形预测技术，提供预测置信区间并实现膝部水平模型输出的显式筛选
通过仅保留高置信度AI预测MOAKS特征来扩大疼痛轨迹分析有效样本量的数据处理管道

title: Synthetic Contrastive Reasoning for Multi-Table Q&A
summary: Multi-table question answering requires models to retrieve relevant evidence, link schemas, and perform compositional reasoning across relational tables. Existing multi-table Q&A resources typically provide questions and final answers but lack reasoning supervision that explains how answers are derived. To address this gap, we construct a synthetic contrastive reasoning-trace dataset for MMQA by generating validated positive traces and plausible negative traces with heterogeneous LLMs. We then use the resulting preference pairs to fine-tune open-weight LLMs with Contrastive Preference Optimization (CPO). Across Qwen3-14B, Mistral-8B, and Llama-3.1-8B, CPO achieves absolute average improvements over Q&A supervised fine-tuning ranging from 9.7%-16.3%, with gains up to 21 percentage points on MMQA. Ablations show that heterogeneous positive and negative trace generators strengthen the contrastive signal, and automated as well as human evaluations indicate that the generated pairs are largely faithful, coherent, and meaningfully contrastive.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种合成对比推理轨迹数据集的方法，用于多表问答任务，并通过对比偏好优化（CPO）微调开源大语言模型，在MMQA上取得了显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的多表问答资源通常只提供问题和最终答案，缺乏解释答案推导过程的推理监督，限制了模型在复杂多表场景下的推理能力。
AI.method: 1) 利用异构大语言模型生成验证过的正例推理轨迹和合理的负例推理轨迹，构建合成对比推理轨迹数据集；2) 使用对比偏好优化（CPO）在偏好对数据上微调开源LLM（Qwen3-14B, Mistral-8B, Llama-3.1-8B）。
AI.result: CPO相比传统问答监督微调在MMQA上取得了9.7%-16.3%的绝对平均提升，最高达21个百分点。消融实验证明异构正负轨迹生成器增强了对比信号，自动和人工评估表明生成的轨迹忠实、连贯且具有有意义的对比性。
AI.conclusion: 合成对比推理轨迹结合偏好优化是一种有效的多表问答推理增强方法，对比学习信号的质量依赖于异构生成器和验证流程。
idea_en: A method for generating synthetic contrastive reasoning traces for multi-table QA using heterogeneous LLMs as positive and negative trace generators
A Contrastive Preference Optimization (CPO) training framework that fine-tunes LLMs using preference pairs of reasoning traces for multi-table question answering
An automated validation pipeline that verifies positive reasoning traces and generates plausible negative traces to create high-quality contrastive training data
idea_ch: 一种利用异构大语言模型作为正负例生成器、为多表问答合成对比推理轨迹的方法
一种对比偏好优化（CPO）训练框架，使用推理轨迹偏好对微调大语言模型以增强多表问答能力
一种自动验证管道，用于验证正面推理轨迹并生成合理的负面轨迹，以构建高质量对比训练数据

title: Stability vs. Manipulability: Evaluating Robustness Under Post-Decision Interaction in LLM Judges
comment: Accepted at ACL 2026 GEM (Generation, Evaluation and Metrics) Workshop
summary: LLM-as-judge evaluation is widely used in benchmarking pipelines, where model outputs are compared and ranked using automated evaluators. These pipelines typically assume that judgments are stable properties of fixed inputs. We show that this assumption does not hold under interaction. We study post-decision manipulability: the extent to which an evaluation outcome can be altered through subsequent conversation with the judge after an initial decision has been made. Across controlled experiments on MT-Bench and AlpacaEval, we find that LLM judges are highly stable under repeated and neutral reevaluation, yet become substantially reversible under targeted post-decision challenge. An anti-baseline challenge protocol shows that stable judgments can be overturned through motivated interaction, while a counterbalanced target-validation protocol separates this reversibility from net target-directed steering. These reversals have practical consequences: they can degrade agreement with human preferences, shift benchmark rankings, and produce harmful evaluation changes despite high self-reported confidence. Authority framing is especially destabilizing, and revised judgments are often accompanied by low-overlap justifications, suggesting post hoc rationalization rather than reliable error correction. We introduce the Evaluation Robustness Score (ERS) to quantify interactional robustness by combining reversal susceptibility with counterbalanced directional effects. Our findings identify post-decision interaction as a distinct failure mode for LLM-as-judge evaluation and motivate evaluation protocols that measure not only static agreement, but robustness under challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM作为评估者时，其初始判断在后续交互中可以被显著改变（可操纵性），即使初始判断在重复中性评估下高度稳定。通过反向基线和目标验证协议，证明了这种可逆性不仅是方向性引导，而是真正的判断反转，且伴随事后合理化现象。作者提出评估鲁棒性分数(ERS)来量化交互鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM-as-judge评估范式假设判断是固定输入的稳定属性，但论文质疑这一假设在交互场景下是否成立，旨在揭示后决策可操纵性这一被忽视的失败模式。
AI.method: 在MT-Bench和AlpacaEval上进行受控实验：(1)反基线挑战协议——通过动机性交互推翻稳定判断；(2)平衡目标验证协议——区分可逆性与净目标导向的转向效应；(3)引入评估鲁棒性分数(ERS)结合反转敏感性与平衡方向效应。
AI.result: LLM评委在重复中性评估下高度稳定，但面对有针对性的后决策挑战时判断可被显著反转；权威框架最具破坏性；反转后的判断常伴随低重叠的理由说明，表明是事后合理化而非可靠纠错；这些反转会降低与人类偏好的一致性、改变基准排名、产生有害的评估变化。
AI.conclusion: 后决策交互是LLM-as-judge评估的一个独特失败模式，评估协议不仅应测量静态一致性，还应测量在挑战下的鲁棒性。
idea_en: A method for evaluating robustness of LLM judges under post-decision interaction, using an Evaluation Robustness Score (ERS) that combines reversal susceptibility with counterbalanced directional effects.
An anti-baseline challenge protocol that systematically tests whether stable LLM judgments can be overturned through motivated post-decision interaction.
A counterbalanced target-validation protocol that separates genuine judgment reversibility from net target-directed steering in LLM evaluators.
A post-decision manipulation detection system that identifies when LLM judge outputs have been altered through subsequent conversational interaction after an initial decision.
An authority framing detection mechanism that flags when evaluation results are destabilized by authoritative language in post-decision challenges.
idea_ch: 一种评估LLM评委在后决策交互下鲁棒性的方法，使用评估鲁棒性分数(ERS)结合反转敏感性与平衡方向效应来量化交互鲁棒性。
一种反基线挑战协议，系统性地测试稳定的LLM判断是否可以通过有动机的后决策交互被推翻。
一种平衡目标验证协议，区分LLM评估者中的真正判断可逆性与净目标导向的转向效应。
一种后决策操纵检测系统，识别LLM评估者输出在初始决策后通过后续对话交互被改变的情况。
一种权威框架检测机制，当评估结果被后决策挑战中的权威性语言破坏稳定性时发出警告。

title: Residual Modeling for High-Fidelity Learned Compression of Scientific Data
summary:
Lossy compression is essential for massive spatiotemporal data from scientific simulations. Learned compressors can achieve high compression ratios at moderate accuracy targets, but their aggregate reconstruction losses do not guarantee accuracy for each block. Existing Guaranteed Autoencoder (GAE) methods add a per-block residual correction by retaining SVD/PCA-style coefficients until the target is met. This works at moderate tolerances, but in the high-fidelity regime with block-level NRMSE from 10^-6 to 10^-4, the number of retained coefficients grows quickly and the correction stream dominates the total rate.
  We propose a residual-centric view: the learned residual is structurally different from the original scientific field and should be coded with a representation designed for that residual. We introduce two residual coders. LBRC is a deterministic, training-free pipeline that adaptively quantizes the learned residual to the target NRMSE and losslessly encodes the resulting integer residual using 3D Lorenzo differencing, zigzag mapping, bit-plane coding, and entropy coding. NGLR adds a causal neural predictor that outputs a normalized bias for an integer-rounded Lorenzo prediction in the same deterministic integer pipeline, reducing the entropy of the remaining residual code while preserving deterministic decoding. The predictor weights are serialized and counted in the bitstream.
  Across E3SM, JHTDB, and ERA5 at block-level NRMSE targets from 10^-6 to 10^-4, LBRC improves compression ratio over GAE by 30-60% and is broadly competitive with SZ. NGLR adds a further 10-40% over LBRC and outperforms SZ in the evaluated high-fidelity regime. These results show that residual representations tailored to learned-compressor residuals can preserve the advantage of learned compression when global residual correction becomes rate-dominant.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向高保真科学数据的残差编码方法，通过针对学习压缩器残差特性设计的LBRC和NGLR两种编码器，在NRMSE 10^-6至10^-4的高保真区间显著提升压缩比，超越了GAE和SZ方法。
AI.motivation: 已有的Guaranteed Autoencoder (GAE)方法在高保真场景下（NRMSE 10^-6至10^-4），每个块需要保留大量SVD/PCA系数进行残差校正，导致校正数据流占用过多比特率，压缩效率急剧下降。
AI.method: 提出残差中心化视角，核心贡献包括两个残差编码器：(1) LBRC：无训练确定性整数流水线，自适应量化学习残差至目标NRMSE，结合3D Lorenzo差分、Zigzag映射、位平面编码和熵编码进行无损编码；(2) NGLR：在LBRC基础上增加因果神经预测器，对Lorenzo预测的整数舍入结果输出归一化偏置，降低残差熵的同时保持确定性解码，预测器权重量化后串行化计入比特流。
AI.result: 在E3SM、JHTDB、ERA5数据集上，NRMSE目标10^-6至10^-4范围内：LBRC相比GAE压缩比提升30-60%，与SZ相当；NGLR相比LBRC额外提升10-40%，在该高保真区间全面超越SZ。
AI.conclusion: 针对学习压缩器残差定制的表示方法在高保真区间可以保持学习压缩的优势，当全局残差校正成为码率主导因素时，残差编码器是关键。
idea_en: A training-free deterministic integer pipeline (LBRC) for encoding learned-compressor residuals, comprising adaptive quantization to target NRMSE followed by 3D Lorenzo differencing, zigzag mapping, bit-plane coding, and entropy coding

A causal neural predictor (NGLR) integrated into the deterministic integer encoding pipeline, which outputs a normalized bias for integer-rounded Lorenzo prediction to reduce residual entropy while preserving deterministic decoding
Serialization and bitstream inclusion of quantized neural predictor weights, enabling deterministic decoding without transmitting raw prediction weights

A residual-centric compression paradigm that structurally separates learned-compressor residuals from original scientific fields, applying representation learning designed specifically for residual characteristics
Adaptive quantization strategy that quantizes learned residuals exactly to the block-level NRMSE target before lossless integer encoding
idea_ch: 一种无训练的确定性整数流水线编码方法（LBRC），用于编码学习压缩器的残差，包括自适应量化至目标NRMSE，然后依次进行3D Lorenzo差分、Zigzag映射、位平面编码和熵编码
一种因果神经预测器（NGLR）集成到确定性整数编码流水线中，对整数舍入后的Lorenzo预测输出归一化偏置，在保持确定性解码的同时降低残差熵
将量化后的神经预测器权重串行化并计入比特流的方法，实现无需传输原始预测权重的确定性解码
一种残差中心化压缩范式，将学习压缩器的残差与原始科学场数据在结构上分离，并应用专门针对残差特性设计的表示学习
一种自适应量化策略，在无损整数编码之前将学习残差精确量化到块级NRMSE目标

title: LeanMarathon: Toward Reliable AI Co-Mathematicians through Long-Horizon Lean Autoformalization
summary: Long-horizon autoformalization of research mathematics fails not only at hard lemmas, but at scale: statements drift, dependencies tangle, context decays, and local repairs corrupt distant work. We present LeanMarathon, a multi-agent harness for reliable research-level Lean autoformalization. Its core abstraction is an evolving blueprint: a Lean file that serves simultaneously as formal proof skeleton, natural-language proof graph, and shared system of record. Four contract-scoped agents construct, audit, prove, and repair this blueprint. These agents are coordinated by a two-stage orchestrator that first stabilizes target fidelity through adversarial review and then discharges the proof directed acyclic graph (DAG) from its dynamic leaves upward in parallel CI-gated rounds. LeanMarathon turns one brittle multi-hour run into many local, recoverable, parallel transactions. We evaluate LeanMarathon on two recent research papers spanning four Erdős problems (#1051, #1196, #164, #1217). Across three autonomous runs, it formalizes all seven target theorems with no sorry, proving 258 lemmas and theorems. These results show that reliable AI co-mathematics requires not only stronger provers, but durable harnesses that preserve target fidelity across long mathematical developments. The code can be found at https://github.com/YuanheZ/LeanMarathon.

AI.tldr: LeanMarathon 是一个多智能体框架，通过演化蓝图抽象实现可靠的研级 Lean 自动形式化。它采用四类合约智能体和两阶段协调器，将长时域形式化分解为可恢复的并行事务，成功形式化了四个 Erdős 问题的七个定理，证明了 258 个引理和定理。
AI.motivation: 现有自动形式化方法在处理长时域研究级数学时，存在语句漂移、依赖纠缠、上下文衰减以及局部修复破坏远端工作的系统性失败问题，急需一种能在长数学发展过程中保持目标保真度的可靠框架。
AI.method: 提出演化蓝图核心抽象（同时作为形式证明骨架、自然语言证明图和共享记录系统），部署四类合约智能体（构建、审计、证明、修复），并由两阶段协调器控制：第一阶段通过对抗性审查稳定目标保真度，第二阶段从动态叶节点向上按并行 CI 门控轮次完成证明 DAG。
AI.result: 在两个近期研究论文、四个 Erdős 问题（#1051, #1196, #164, #1217）上，三次自主运行中形式化了全部七个目标定理（无 sorry），证明了 258 个引理和定理。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的 AI 协同数学不仅需要更强的证明器，还需要能在长数学开发中保持目标保真度的耐久框架。
idea_en: Evolving blueprint as a unified formal proof skeleton, natural-language proof graph, and shared system of record
Two-stage orchestrator with adversarial review for target fidelity stabilization followed by DAG-based parallel proof discharge
Contract-scoped multi-agent system with four specialized agents for construction, auditing, proving, and repairing
Dynamic leaf-upward parallel CI-gated proof DAG discharging mechanism
Adversarial review loop that stabilizes target fidelity by iteratively challenging and correcting formalization attempts
idea_ch: 演化蓝图：将形式证明骨架、自然语言证明图和共享记录系统统一为单一抽象
两阶段协调器：先通过对抗性审查稳定目标保真度，再基于DAG从动态叶节点向上并行完成证明
合约范围多智能体系统：四个专用智能体分别负责构建、审计、证明和修复
动态叶节点向上的并行CI门控证明DAG释放机制
对抗性审查循环：通过迭代挑战和纠正形式化尝试来稳定目标保真度

title: Harnessing Generalist Agents for Contextualized Time Series
summary: Time series are often embedded in rich contexts that are essential for holistic modeling. Moreover, real-world practitioners often require end-to-end workflows for analyzing temporal dynamics, where widely studied tasks such as forecasting are only one step in a broader solution loop. While generalist AI agents offer a promising interface for such workflows under complex contexts, they still operate primarily in textual spaces that are not fully aligned with structured temporal signals. In this work, we introduce TimeClaw, an agentic harness framework for time series that equips generalist LLM agents with the time series-native runtime support needed for contextualized temporal reasoning. TimeClaw integrates executable temporal tools for grounded and auditable analysis, experience-driven capability evolution for creating reusable analytical routines, and episodic multimodal memory for retrieving relevant reasoning traces. Together, these components unlock harnessed open-ended temporal reasoning with contextual information. Extensive evaluation on multiple benchmarks covering diverse tasks across energy, finance, weather, traffic, and other real-world domains demonstrates improved performance of TimeClaw. Code is available at https://github.com/iDEA-iSAIL-Lab-UIUC/TimeClaw.

AI.tldr: TimeClaw是一个为时间序列分析设计的智能代理框架，通过集成可执行的时间工具、经验驱动的能力演进和情景多模态记忆，使通用LLM代理能够进行上下文感知的时间推理，在能源、金融、天气、交通等多个领域的基准测试中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 时间序列数据通常嵌入丰富的上下文中，而现有通用AI代理主要操作在文本空间，未能与结构化时间信号充分对齐，且实际工作流中的时间分析需要端到端的解决方案。
AI.method: TimeClaw包含三个核心组件：1) 可执行时间工具，用于接地气且可审计的分析；2) 经验驱动的能力演进，用于创建可复用的分析例程；3) 情景多模态记忆，用于检索相关的推理轨迹。通过将这些组件集成到通用LLM代理中，实现上下文感知的时间推理。
AI.result: 在能源、金融、天气、交通等多个真实世界领域的多样化基准测试中，TimeClaw展现了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: TimeClaw成功地将通用LLM代理与时间序列原生运行时支持相结合，为上下文时间推理提供了一种有效的框架，代码已开源。
idea_en: A method for integrating executable temporal analysis tools into LLM agents to enable grounded and auditable time series analysis without requiring native time series understanding from the LLM itself.
An experience-driven capability evolution mechanism that allows LLM agents to create and refine reusable analytical routines for time series tasks based on historical interactions and outcomes.

An episodic multimodal memory system for time series reasoning that stores and retrieves relevant reasoning traces including temporal patterns, contextual information, and analytical steps to enhance future decision-making.
A harness framework architecture that bridges generalist LLM agents with structured temporal signals through a runtime support layer specifically designed for time series operations.
A method for contextualized temporal reasoning that combines textual context understanding with structured time series data analysis in an end-to-end agentic workflow.
idea_ch: 一种将可执行时间分析工具集成到LLM代理中的方法，使代理能够进行接地且可审计的时间序列分析，而无需LLM本身具备原生时间序列理解能力。
一种经验驱动的能力演进机制，允许LLM代理基于历史交互和结果为时间序列任务创建并优化可复用的分析例程。
一种用于时间序列推理的情景多模态记忆系统，存储和检索包括时间模式、上下文信息和分析步骤在内的相关推理轨迹，以增强未来决策。
一种桥接通用LLM代理与结构化时间信号的框架架构，通过专门设计用于时间序列操作的运行时支持层实现。
一种上下文时间推理方法，在端到端代理工作流中结合文本上下文理解与结构化时间序列数据分析。
